02 / Behind the handle

Curiosity.
Code.
Community.

I’m brick — a Minecraft network owner and content creator with an interest in the systems that keep everything running.

Brickworks is my own network: development, hosting and content. I enjoy both sides of building a network — the code behind it and the community that makes it worth running.

Python and Skript are where I’m most confident. I’m continuing to learn Java, JavaScript, HTML and CSS through plugins, websites and practical tools.

Self-hosting brought me into Linux, Docker and networking. Looking after my own infrastructure means there’s always something new to understand, improve or fix.
